item.text:
I located the parsing faults in [scanner/redhatbase.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:504). Both installed-package line parsers use `strings.Fields`, which removes an empty release field and shifts the remaining fields. Amazon Linux 2 also uses that collapsed field count to choose a parser. Source package version construction always adds `-release`, leaving a trailing hyphen when release is empty.

[splitFileName](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go:698) assumes the architecture follows a dot, so it misreads the requested `-src.rpm` patterns and does not fully validate malformed filenames. The update candidate parser already has CentOS and Amazon coverage for version, release, repository, and numeric epochs in [redhatbase_test.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase_test.go:560); `(none)` epochs remain unverified.

One existing test expects `elasticsearch-8.17.0-1-src.rpm` to be rejected, conflicting with the requested valid `package-0-1-src.rpm` pattern. I recorded the findings in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). **No project source or tests were changed** under this run’s fault-localization constraint. The focused test run was interrupted before it returned a result.
